next_operator_step.purpose: independent new room capture to assess lidar/map localization stability and return-to-mark repeatability; encoder disagreement is diagnostic, not an entry gate
next_operator_step.route: mark start position and heading; translate 0.5–1.0 m where space/cable slack permit, including lateral motion; turn slowly both ways; return near the mark
next_operator_step.record: same full sensor archive, start/end marks and heading, any jumps, map overlap and observed final offset; actual marked distance if available
next_operator_step.evaluation: Replay the new session against the saved map; inspect stable wall alignment and localization continuity. Independently measure final position/heading before claiming physical accuracy. Map/odom disagreement alone does not fail the trial.
next_operator_step.start_requires: fresh supports/space/cable clearance and explicit operator teleop start

unqualified: metric floor distance and yaw calibration
full-height live obstacle clearing and furniture semantics

localization_policy.global_pose_reference: lidar/map matching: SLAM during mapping, AMCL against a saved map
localization_policy.continuous_local_prediction: nominal wheel encoder odom; lidar corrects map-to-odom
localization_policy.disagreement_4_9cm_12deg_is: difference between estimates, not surveyed error or an adopted correction
localization_policy.fault_handling: Keep fresh scan/TF, verified stop and arm/lift hold checks; do not substitute encoder-only autonomous navigation after localization loss.

limitations: same recorded session used to build map and replay localization; not independent accuracy
initial pose hypothesis provided, not global localization from an unknown room
